actions: Confirmed current public Figshare metadata for S1 Code and exact ndownloader file id; binary source remained inaccessible through available safe transport.
Constructed a bounded single-state O(Nk)-class dormant-memory tracker, replacing the prior parallel slow/fast proxy.
Tested nonlinear observations with two persistent task/representation switches, two temporary latent disappear/reappear events, moderate and severe delayed/sparse error.
Calibrated common raw and eta-timescale CUSUM settings on six disjoint streams and evaluated 16 disjoint held-out streams for PAST/GROUSE-like and Oja-like tracker variants.
Computed 5,000-resample paired bootstrap intervals for task-loss differences.
Persisted delta and advanced role-local LATEST pointer with CAS.

result_summary.single_state_memory: feasible at O(N(k+m)) subspace state but naive continuous decoder-loss admission produced high bank churn and no statistically resolved held-out MSE benefit
result_summary.raw_detector: more balanced across tracker families than tested eta-scaled timescale normalization, but still produced about 1-2 false releases per stream and no resolved task-loss improvement
result_summary.severe_feedback_boundary: 40-step delayed, 25%-observed error made release evidence too noisy/late for resolved benefit
result_summary.timescale_normalization: eta-proportional CUSUM integration is specifically disfavored; under severe feedback common normalized setting detected 71.9% of PAST-like switches but only 9.4% of Oja-like switches

termination.exact_next_action: Retry source ZIP when transport permits; replace high-churn memory admission with event-sparse subspace-invariant utility evidence and add an unsupervised residual-change channel; test a tracker-independent standardized evidence/hazard normalization instead of eta-proportional CUSUM scaling.
